user_objective: Find a tree/filtration-based algorithm for adapted optimal transport from paths that is faster or demonstrably better than the strongest comparable methods. Prioritize the cost and tightness of valid root certification. Permit explicitly scoped intermediate results and independently reviewed negative results for a defined mechanism class; neither implies achievement of the original full-domain algorithm objective.

revision.rationale: User-authorized revision after existing results: prioritize certification, admit scoped negative research, and distinguish limited-domain claims from original-objective completion. This is not a blind preregistration and does not retroactively promote evidence.

research_priority.primary: Cost to reach a valid original-target root certificate, or certified interval width at matched total compute budget.
research_priority.development_order: Cheap decisive mechanism probes, independent target/certificate review, work counts and ablation using the same low-level kernels, then system optimization and full confirmation only when justified.
research_priority.novelty_caution: Root propagation, finite-versus-population separation and complete timing are necessary rigor, not by themselves demonstrated novelty or a SOTA win.

scope_policy.original_domain: The target.required_* fields and breadth remain mandatory for original_algorithm_objective_achieved.
scope_policy.limited_domain_results: Allowed with explicit assumptions, coverage, exclusions, counterexamples and limitations. Declare the domain and selection rule before new confirmation; disclose any choice informed by prior failures and use fresh held-out evidence. Do not label limited coverage as full-domain completion.
scope_policy.reference_audit: Follow frozen_design.json reference_audit_policy and its existing amendments. Reducing exact-reference audits does not reduce candidate/comparator coverage. Large-instance certification still requires independent mathematical and numerical validation; small-oracle agreement alone is insufficient.

pot_role: Implementation baseline and small-instance oracle; never a synonym for SOTA.

target.solver_track: Unregularized bicausal/nested OT value on the SAME finite, quantized k-window model, with the output convention V=AW_p^p fixed per task.
target.estimator_track: Population adapted distance from the SAME observed paths; report sampling, grid/window, slicing and solver errors separately. Finite-model certification is not a population certificate.
target.input_access: Observed paths only. Kernel-oracle methods belong to a separately labelled track unless adapted to the same observed information.

breadth.status: Required coverage; concrete generators and parameters must be frozen before experiments.
breadth.restriction_scope: These restrictions disqualify original full-domain completion; explicitly labelled limited-domain research is permitted under scope_policy.
breadth.process_requirement: The second family must have observable non-monotone conditional transitions and true dependence beyond the current state; specify the data-generating law before running. A weakly non-linear relabelling of AR(1) is not sufficient.

time_includes: all warm-up budgets used by a standalone solve
comparison.speed_track: At the same preregistered accuracy/guarantee, compare time-to-certificate against the per-instance fastest eligible competitor.
comparison.quality_track: At the same preregistered total compute budget, compare valid root interval width against the smallest width among eligible competitors. This does not assert smaller unknown true error.
comparison.competitor_policy: Keep PNOT on eligible exact tasks. A method enters a certified comparison only with an audited same-target guarantee and all adapter/certificate costs counted. Missing adapters are unresolved comparison gaps, not wins. A validated exact method remains a potential frontier competitor.
comparison.timing_interpretation: Wall-clock supports practical performance claims; work counts and same-kernel ablation support mechanism claims. Do not rank against published times measured on other hardware or under other timing boundaries.

engineering_defaults.note: Proposed reproducibility defaults, not mathematical constants or extra user requirements. Freeze revisions with reasons BEFORE results; never silently relax after failures.

completion.applies_to: original_algorithm_objective_achieved requires empirical, tree_mechanism and novelty together; the separate research_outcomes do not bypass these gates.
completion.empirical: A frozen implementation passes all required tasks and independent certification checks, has no confirmed regression against the qualified comparison frontier, and a preregistered material speed OR certified-quality gain survives held-out replication.
completion.tree_mechanism: A precise mechanism connects temporal/conditional structure to omitted or shared computation; independent proof review, adversarial tests, work counts and an ablation support this mechanism.
completion.novelty: Closest prior art and overlap are documented and independently reviewed. A new combination is not called novel merely because its score improved.
not_completion: a scoped negative result or limited-domain result presented as original full-domain algorithm success

research_outcomes.original_algorithm_objective_achieved: All completion gates pass on the original required domain; only this outcome permits scientific_objective_achieved=true.

scoped_negative_research_complete.definition: An independently reviewed, reproducible result establishes a precisely limited obstruction or lower bound for a defined mechanism/algorithm class. No new faster algorithm is required for this separate outcome.
required_evidence: Explicit target, model domain, algorithm/mechanism class, information or oracle access, cost model, accuracy and quantifiers (worst-case, distributional or instance-specific).
A precise obstruction or lower-bound statement with proof, independent proof review and adversarial checks; a restricted-class bound must not be generalized to all algorithms.
Work metrics aligned with the claim, accounting for detection, certification and preprocessing; quantitative empirical claims require disclosed selection and held-out replication.
Nearest-prior-art comparison, limitations, reproducible artifacts and an independent assessment of the contribution. Publication acceptance is not promised.
insufficient_evidence: High fractions of distinct optimal witnesses alone.
Failure of several related mechanisms treated as independent proof of impossibility.
Occupation-mass failure substituted for a distinct-entry work lower bound.
An observed 1/w scaling on a fixed Sinkhorn probe treated as a universal lower bound.

research_outcomes.limited_domain_result: A result valid only under declared restrictions; package with its own evidence and limitations while leaving the original objective unachieved.
research_outcomes.direction_stopped_evidence_based: A reviewed decision to stop a particular direction because aligned probes or cost diagnostics do not justify further investment. Preserve evidence, alternatives and unresolved questions; this is neither an impossibility theorem nor research completion.
research_outcomes.execution_blocked: Missing resources or session limits require an honest checkpoint, not a mathematical conclusion.
